projects.title: Learning Management System (LMS)
projects.tech: React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, Prisma, MySQL
details: Built a full-stack LMS with a React and TypeScript front end, an Express.js REST API, and a MySQL database accessed through Prisma ORM with 15 models.
Implemented JWT authentication with bcrypt password hashing and role-based access for 3 roles (Admin, Instructor, Student), with Zod request validation.
Created 49 REST API endpoints and 33 React pages covering courses, modules, lessons, subscription-based course access, payments, and student management.
Developed lesson progress tracking that unlocks timed quizzes with attempt limits, plus assignment ZIP submission with grading, and course certificates.

projects.title: Full Stack Student Management System
projects.tech: React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, Sequelize, MySQL, Axios
details: Built a full-stack application with a React and TypeScript front end, a Node.js/Express REST API, and a MySQL database.
Designed 5 REST API endpoints in Express.js (GET all, GET by ID, POST, PUT, DELETE) that return JSON responses with 5 HTTP status codes (200, 201, 400, 404, 500).
Defined the Student model using Sequelize ORM (4 required fields, unique email) and added server-side validation for required fields and duplicate emails when creating a student.
Created 4 routed pages (Dashboard, Students, Add Student, Edit Student) with React Router and Bootstrap; the dashboard shows total students, departments, average age, and recent students.
Wrote 2 custom hooks: useAPI (Axios requests with loading and error handling) and useStudent (useReducer state for fetching and deleting students).

projects.title: Shopping Cart Application
projects.tech: React.js, TypeScript, Vite, React Router, Bootstrap, JSON Server
details: Built a responsive e-commerce application with 10 routed pages and 10 components, covering product listing, product details, variants, cart, wishlist, checkout, order history, and user profile.
Managed global state for authentication, cart, and wishlist using 3 React Context providers, with cart and wishlist data kept separate for each logged-in user.
Integrated REST APIs using the Fetch API through a reusable request client, 5 service modules, and a generic useApi hook that handles loading and error states.
Added product search, category filtering, price filtering, and sorting, and defined 6 TypeScript interfaces for products, variants, cart items, users, orders, and order items.
